label: Chat RCON
description: Lets referees and admins run server console commands from chat with !rcon <command>. Referees (permission level Referee Permission Level and up) may run only the Referee-Allowed Commands; admins (Admin Permission Level and up) may run anything except the Admin-Denied Commands. Takes over the stock !rcon while enabled, and every use is written to the server log.

commands.name: rcon
commands.description: Runs a console command from chat if your permission level allows it.

cvars.label: Referee Permission Level
cvars.description: Minimum minqlx permission level treated as a referee tier.

cvars.label: Admin Permission Level
cvars.description: Minimum minqlx permission level treated as the admin tier.

cvars.label: Referee-Allowed Commands
cvars.description: Comma-separated RCON commands referees are allowed to run.

cvars.label: Admin-Denied Commands
cvars.description: Comma-separated RCON commands even admins are not allowed to run.
